http://purl.org/dc/terms/description: Five proxy records from the EPICA Dome C ice core, East Antarctica: methane, deuterium, dust, the oxygen isotope composition of trapped air, and the oxygen to nitrogen ratio of trapped air. The records rest on four different depth-age models and are not on a common time axis; each observation names the chronology its age comes from.
